candidates.name: MD Partitions Inc.
candidates.partition_evidence: Homepage: 'supplies and installs toilet partitions, stalls, lockers, accessories, and other Division 10 specialties' in MD, DC and VA. Projects page lists US Capitol, State Department, Walter Reed, Ft. Belvoir, Silver Spring Metro and DC schools.
red_flags: Supplies partitions itself (stock partitions, 48-hour delivery): buy-around risk
candidates.reason: Jessup is about 20 miles from DC. It supplies and installs toilet partitions for commercial and institutional clients across MD, DC and VA, with many DC-area projects. It's also a partition supplier, so it's a buy-around risk.

license.name: MD Partitions Inc.
license.registry: DC DLCP SCOUT (Verify a Business License, scout.dcra.dc.gov); Maryland Home Improvement Commission public query (residential only)
license.note: Jobs in DC need a DC Basic Business License in a contractor category (DLCP). DLCP's own page names SCOUT (https://scout.dcra.dc.gov/) as the place to verify a business license. SCOUT is a JavaScript single-page app and couldn't be queried automatically; scout.dlcp.dc.gov didn't connect. Maryland has no state license for commercial work. The MHIC lookup (https://www.dllr.state.md.us/cgi-bin/ElectronicLicensing/OP_search/OP_search.cgi?calling_app=HIC::HIC_business_name) covers residential home improvement only and is behind a reCAPTCHA. No license status was read; check SCOUT by hand. Base city: Jessup, MD.

candidates.name: Partition Plus, Inc.
candidates.partition_evidence: Service areas page: installation covers Baltimore, Washington DC, Delaware, Pennsylvania and Virginia, mostly with in-house crews and some subcontractors. About page: has supplied and installed commercial restroom partitions since 1993.
red_flags: Online partition reseller of the same brands Next Partitions sells: a direct competitor and a strong buy-around risk
candidates.reason: It does install commercial partitions in DC and Virginia, but it's a direct online competitor selling the same brands, and its Forest Hill base is outside the 30-mile radius.
